{{import file-header}}

#include <print>
#include <ranges>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <exception>
#include <sak/ensure.hpp>
#include <sak/ranges/contains.hpp>
#include <sak/using.hpp>
{{list_open include_list}}#include <{{list_item include_list}}>
{{list_close include_list}}

auto main( const int argument_count, const char* argument_values[ ] ) -> int
{
	__using( ::sak::, exit_success, exit_failure, ensure )
	__using( ::std::, string, vector, println, exception )
	__using( ::sak::ranges::, contains )

	const vector< string > arguments( argument_values, argument_values + argument_count );

	if( contains( arguments, { "-h", "--help" } ) )
	{
		println( "this executable is a battery of tests about: {{hierarchy}}" );
		return	exit_success;
	}
	try
	{
		println( "starting tests for: {{hierarchy}}" );

		//	--------------------------------------------------
		//	todo: implement tests here
		//	signature: `ensure( bool expression, const std::string& message )`
		//	example:   `ensure( 1 + 1 == 2, "math is broken" );`
		//	--------------------------------------------------

		println( "all tests for {{hierarchy}} passed" );
	}
	catch( const exception& error )
	{
		println( "test failed: {}", error.what( ) );
		return	exit_failure;
	}

	return	exit_success;
}
